newsitem.title: THAILAND: Juldis Develop to issue 95 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Juldis Develop to issue 95 mln new shrs.

text.p: Thai property developer Juldis Develop Plc said on Thursday it will raise registered capital to 1.5 billion baht ($57.7 million) from 550 million baht by issuing 95 million new shares.
The new shares will be privately offered to institutional investors at 10 baht each, Juldis said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The proceeds from the new shares will be used to reduce its existing debt burden and to finance its property developement projects, the company said.
